checks: Only explicit provider provisioning responses produce a pending desktop state. Malformed/error replies fail without provider payload leakage.
Desktop URL requests explicitly require private access.
Retired, archiving and foreign Companions cause no provider desktop call through the authenticated API.
Owned verification containers and volumes are absent after success and the preceding typecheck failure.
limits: This does not correct or prove resolution of intermittent provider noVNC service startup.
Provider desktop response shapes follow the official documented contract; authenticated API rejection is verified with a stubbed provider boundary.
